Good to know

Admission & placement questions

Which courses can GB GROUP guide me through? +

Engineering, management, computer applications, healthcare, law, design, humanities and diploma programmes, along with admission support in recognised institutions.

Do you help with scholarships or education loans? +

We provide guidance on eligible scholarship schemes and education loan documentation. Eligibility depends on the institution and the student's profile.

Is placement support guaranteed? +

We provide resume preparation, interview coaching and referrals to active hiring partners. Final selection is decided by the employer, so we do not promise guaranteed jobs.

Can students from one state apply in the other? +

Yes. We regularly guide students from Jharkhand seeking colleges in West Bengal and vice versa.
